title: What the Strips Gave Back

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The field gives back what the fist would not count. The yard goes around the place in the returning line and calls it weather. A number goes from the strip to a man's teeth and back again and is given to nobody. The house keeps its days in loaves and the fire keeps four, four and a gap. Ask the pot. Ask the weather. Nobody is told what the harvest cost.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Vail kiln-house, kept over the middle tend of Grain

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and twenty-two to two hundred and twenty-four days, six months and forty-two days to six months and forty-four days, carried everywhere and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing --- a cost asked as a direction answered with the pot and the weather, the carrying arm as a record in muscle that knows weight and not cost, the first grain taken apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set on a place of its own, the private file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing, and an inch of a small hand asked again under a roof the market cannot enter --- without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line --- the old life stays offstage --- and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no hearing beyond six, no seventh of the full note, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end, no third telling of the counting room shut in the war, no opening, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no joining of the seventh green to the seventh shape, no name spoken over either, no calling of the loan, no payer named, no private record read, no figure given for the harvest or for the hand that did not come back, no betrayal paid and no ending

scenes.title: The Middle Tend
scenes.synopsis: First entry, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap: Day 222, Grain 13, Thirdday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf and the Clay Yard. No recap: the hand lies down against the fold after the two-rhythm letting-go of the night before and that coordination is set down like a tool, not recalled as a sign, growth, reaching or power. First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that, with the sour Ash breath of the unswept corner the house calls the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. The boy is two hundred and twenty-two days old and six months and forty-two days and nobody says so (T071/T072); the carried fire gives four low pulls and withholds its fifth, its payer unnamed for two hundred and twenty-two days (T088); the river's note of water over water through the finger's-width door, the fire's gap under the floor and the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot are three counts in three places that do not become one, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). One leathery brown-edged crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. The file is turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of a person and no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying and the fourth burned-slate telling on their own places, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Grain's first reading and the true subtraction in Berr's locked box, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape on places that do not touch (T061/T082, T036/T076, T035/T031/T065/T095, T006, T050/T051, T033/T034). Sella comes to the fire before the basket: instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind, never the basket; the house; half-pace; jar-glance and hand half-shut; lips along the two-gapped row without a figure; finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread; pot rim set with handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, a half-beat longer at the setting, no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched, no opening in forty-two days (T058/T079, T100). Garl is kept in objects, not a story: salt coat, hollow seat, two unswept lines called the thaw, proverb gone to the pot, tile debt circled without a name; no lesson, no collector, name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-two days (T009/T013/T092). Word over the boards: the harvest has come to the worked strips east of Low Kiln and hands are going back into them, the first cut grain counted in glances and handfuls and never in a figure --- a direction with no number at its foot, taken apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and filed on a place of its own (T077, T098 held). Cost-questions at the door go to the pot and the weather (T077). Morning hand: up an inch toward the note, down at once against the fold --- a miss with no failure hidden in it, filed on the sixth place, laid across nothing, no payer named (T061/T082). Grain 20 (Day 229) is five mornings ahead and is not brought early.

scenes.title: What the Strips Gave Back
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 222, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The chapter's one meaningful change, gathered and not paid: the first grain of the harvest comes back off the worked strips east of Low Kiln and the yard counts it in glances and handfuls and never in a figure, a bundle set down and a pot covered, the carrying arm reading weight and not cost; and the yard goes around the empty place in the returning line where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, with a look and a wide step and no number (T098 advanced and NOT paid --- no name, no cause, no accident, no body, no identification and no figure --- held for the far-off day a body is found or a figure is given; T077, T009/T013/T092, T071/T072). No third gap comes and no fourth likeness stands up to make a cause of the returning-line place, the pan's gone round ring, the rack space, the bare trough and the field's empty place. Sella with her back to the basket: lips along the two-gapped row, no figure; jar-glance and hand half-shut; finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal stays unread; fire told the thaw; coals turned with the back of a broken pot; The house will keep it; count under the breath toward no opening; grey streak pale as she pushes hair back with the burn-wrist; pot handle two inches beyond the hand and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched at an afternoon and a dusk, no opening in forty-two days (T058/T079, T100). Garl kept to the day without a story: coat, hollow seat, two unswept lines, proverb gone to the pot, tile debt neither paid nor settled nor named; name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-two days (T009/T013/T092). Tarn: broom taken only after instruction; Six counted. The next I don't count; knife at the very edge, six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip; Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it; ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping, not a new one, breath drawn and not spent; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; Seed 16 unspent and loan uncalled; stroke past the bright patch and over the collector's road without the half-check or a turn, no collector; warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Jorra: meal-fine slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, white in a knuckle where a fist opened, not bone-coloured slip; dusty and clean forearms on one tray; men unnamed into the finger's-width-open back room before first grey, room not called cold, two shut-room tellings still two, burned-slate word told four times still a direction arrived nowhere; speaks to the wheel (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), tells a pot You'll do, withholds the full note; bent finger held in the damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition; three pot sayings stay sayings, no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, he's not Vail sealed, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T061/T082). Carry home at the going of the light at the half-pace, woodsmoke before in long low bars and river wind behind with water over water, wide around each absence with a look and no number; bed, not loft; fold right, thread frozen (T058/T079, T098). Small hours: hand up an inch, held for the small intake only, down before the letting go --- an honest fraction shorter than the whole breath, on its sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Cost Asked as a Direction
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 223, Grain 14, Fourthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the Clay Yard, the wheel-shed edge and the yard well. New day, new date, no recap: two hundred and twenty-three days old, six months and forty-three days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and twenty-three days (T088); fire, river and boards keep three counts in three places (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow; first sound the kiln in fours with a gap, no bell and no market. The day opens on the harvest's second working morning: a neighbour at the well asks what the reaping will take now that hands are back in the strips, and Sella sends the question to the pot and the weather with Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it; a man off the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back in his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere (T077). Grain's first arithmetic goes on unread under the roof: printed one in twelve unchallenged, figure read on Grain 10 still not the figure paid, true subtraction locked in Berr's box up the road, Hessa's slate gone up unread, soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing for his uncalled measure --- all held in the boy's file and none reached back (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held). The seventh green and seventh shape stay a colour and a shape on places that do not touch, now three days gathered, with no eighth of either, no second look joined, no name spoken over either, no loaf, no slate and no sale, neither woman nor child called Fenna or Ulda in the narration, neither promoted into a hearing, a cause or a romance (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough whose water is called weather, the field's empty place and the returning-line place, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092/T098). Sella's instruction grammar, the house, half-pace, jar-glance and hand half-shut, lips along the two-gapped row, finger above the charcoal, pot handle two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched, no opening in forty-three days (T058/T079, T100). Tarn: Six counted. The next I don't count; knife at the lip, six where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot; ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping; nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; Seed 16 unspent and loan uncalled; no collector on Grain 14; stroke over the flagstones past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn; warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062). Jorra: meal-fine dust past the bent finger, dirty and clean forearms on one tray, pot told You'll do, three sayings about a pot with no lesson made and no name for what ailed the carried man; burned-slate word a fourth direction arrived nowhere, two shut-room tellings still two; bent finger in the damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition; he's not Vail sealed, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Morning hand: up an inch, down before the counted breath has finished --- an honest miss on the sixth place, laid across nothing, no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The First Grain Kept
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 223, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. A first bundle of cut grain is set near the fire under the roof and covered, counted by the carrying arm as weight and not cost, entered on no slate and given no figure; the house keeps its days in loaves and glances and the bundle takes its place beside the row's two unnamed gaps without joining them (T077, T060/T086, T071/T072). Sella at the shelf with her back to the basket: lips along a row with two unnamed gaps and no figure, jar-glance and hand half-shut, finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal stays unread, fire told the thaw, coals turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, count under the breath, grey streak pale as she pushes hair back with the burn-wrist, pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with the half-beat at the setting, no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched since before the kiln on Ember 1, no opening in forty-three days; private roll unshown, Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100). Garl kept to the day without a story: salt-stiff coat with the crease at the left shoulder, the seat's twenty-year hollow and lean, clean dark line and finer hairline called the thaw unswept, proverb gone to a pot with no crack, tile debt circled without a name and worse for being uncalled; name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-three days (T009/T013/T092). Tarn: Six counted. The next I don't count at the kindling, knife at the edge, Garl's unforged sentence beside it; ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping; nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; Seed 16 unspent, loan uncalled, no collector on Grain 14; stroke past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn; stone cold in its unmarked loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Jorra: meal-fine dust past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms on one tray, pot told You'll do, three shapings of the pot saying stand as sayings about a pot with no lesson made and no name for what ailed the carried man; burned-slate word a fourth direction arrived nowhere, two shut-room tellings still two; bent finger in the damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition; he's not Vail sealed, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T061/T082). Carry home at the going of the light at the half-pace, woodsmoke before in long low bars, river wind behind with water over water, wide around each absence with a look and no number; bed, not loft; fold right, thread frozen (T058/T079, T098). Small hours: with no breathing number anywhere in the house, hand up an inch and kept to the river's own low interval --- draw, slack, small pause --- and down on the next low note, the one-rhythm coordination remembered, not a change made again, filed on the sixth place and laid across nothing, no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Place in the Returning Line
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 224, Grain 15, Fifthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the Clay Yard, the wheel-shed edge, the yard well and the worked strips' edge. New day, new date, no recap: two hundred and twenty-four days old, six months and forty-four days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and twenty-four days (T088); three counts in three places do not become one (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that; first sound the kiln in fours with a gap, no bell and no market. Grain 10 is three mornings behind and Grain 20 (Day 229) is five mornings ahead; neither brought early. The harvest's third working morning: hands come out of the worked strips with the first cut grain and the yard goes around the empty place in the returning line once more with a look and a wide step and no number --- no name, no cause, no accident, no body, no figure and no payment; the boy files it beside the disappearing hand's other goings-around and forbids it to stand up with the shelf's two gaps, the fold's one crust and its gap, the pan's gone ring and the field's empty place, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and no payer stands to any (T098 advanced, NOT paid; T060/T086/T097, T009/T013/T092). A wrong-wind voice over the boards lets one of the three shapings of the pot saying stand --- a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw --- and the boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and leaves it a saying about a pot with no pot lost, no fourth likeness made a cause and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T061/T082, T064). Cost-questions at the door and the well go to the pot and the weather and arrive nowhere, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077). The district's changed arithmetic goes on unread under this roof: printed one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, true subtraction in Berr's locked box, Hessa's slate gone up unread, soft-cuffed clerk set for his uncalled measure (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held). The seventh green and seventh shape remain a colour and a shape gathered three days ago, with no eighth, no joining, no name, no loaf, no slate and no sale (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced). Sella's instruction grammar, house, half-pace, jar-glance, hand half-shut, lips along the two-gapped row, finger above the charcoal, pot handle two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched, no opening in forty-four days (T058/T079, T100). Tarn: Six counted. The next I don't count, knife at the edge, ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping, nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 unspent, loan uncalled, no collector on Grain 15, stone cold in its loft pot; agrees with the early thaw and the late and keeps wanting the late because it puts off the paying (T036/T076, T006, T062). Jorra: meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms on one tray, speaks to the wheel and tells a pot You'll do, withholds the note; burned-slate word a fourth direction arrived nowhere, two shut-room tellings still two; bent finger in the damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition; he's not Vail sealed, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Morning hand: up an inch toward the note, down at once against the fold under conditions that had sometimes answered --- an honest miss and no failure hidden under it, filed on the sixth place, no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the File Kept
scenes.synopsis: Sixth entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 224, Grain 15, Fifthday, afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending; heat settles under the shelf, behind the pot and into the fold where one stiff brown-edged crust lies two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint with afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody performs. The first grain of the harvest stays under the roof in its covered bundle, counted in glances and by the carrying arm's weight and never in a figure, entered on no slate; the returning-line place stays gone around with a look and no number (T077, T098 advanced and not paid). Sella at the shelf with her back to the basket: lips along a row with two unnamed gaps and no figure, jar-glance and hand half-shut, finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal stays unread, uncounted and uncopied, fire told the thaw, coals turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, count under the breath toward no opening, grey streak pale as she pushes hair back with the burn-wrist, pot rim set with handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and the half-beat at the setting, no look toward the bed; widow's mark hung where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Ember 1 and at no hour since --- no opening in forty-four days --- private roll unshown, Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100). Garl kept to the day without a story: coat, hollow seat, two unswept lines, proverb gone to the pot, tile debt neither paid nor settled nor named, no lesson, no collector, name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-four days (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn: Six counted. The next I don't count, knife at the very edge, ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping, nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Seed 16 unspent, loan uncalled, no collector on Grain 15, stroke past the bright patch and over the collector's road without the half-check or a turn, warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra: meal-fine dust past the bent finger, pot told You'll do, three shapings of the pot saying stand as sayings about a pot with no lesson made and no name for what ailed the carried man; burned-slate word a fourth direction arrived nowhere, two shut-room tellings still two, bent finger in the damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition; he's not Vail sealed, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T061/T082). Carry home at the going of the light at the half-pace, woodsmoke before in long low bars, river wind behind with water over water, wide around the pan's gone ring, bare trough, rack space with broken birth-slates, field's empty place, carriers' place and the returning-line place, each with a look and a wide step and no number; carrying arm a record in muscle that remembers weight and not cost; bed, not loft; fold right, thread frozen (T058/T079, T098). Small hours: the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing --- six hearings with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers with three shapings of the pot saying advanced and unpaid, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Grain's first reading and the true subtraction in Berr's locked box, nine stoppings with no payer named, three held changes on three places with loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape on places that do not touch, burned-slate word on its own place with a hand between the three; no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, nothing filled to make a row come out even (T061/T082, T050/T051, T033/T034, T036/T076, T035/T031). The hand is asked: up an inch toward the note and, with Sella gone to her bed and the two rooms not touching, taken through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths she counts at her fire, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and brought down on the river's next low note --- the two-rhythm coordination remembered, not a longer reach, a miss, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule, filed on its sixth place with no payer named and not spent or explained; he still cannot close two inches to the pot handle, lift his chin to the crust or speak a number (T061/T082). Count two hundred and twenty-four exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath; fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and twenty-four days; seventh year at its very end and ungiven; seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape, gathered and unjoined; Grain 20 (Day 229) held five mornings off as the second Account-day and market. Forward into Day 225, Grain 16, Sixthday, and Chapter 58.
